title: Mix-CALADIN: A Distributed Algorithm for Consensus Mixed-Integer Optimization
summary: This paper addresses distributed consensus optimization problems with mixed-integer variables, with a specific focus on Boolean variables. We introduce a novel distributed algorithm that extends the Consensus Augmented Lagrangian Alternating Direction Inexact Newton (CALADIN) framework by incorporating specialized techniques for handling Boolean variables without relying on local mixed-integer solvers. Under the mild assumption of Lipschitz continuity of the objective functions, we establish rigorous convergence guarantees for both convex and nonconvex mixed-integer programming problems.…
